mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical ten-period Ehlers Fisher Transform turning-point crossover on completed four-hour BTC auctions maps bounded range location into a near-Gaussian extreme scale and identifies a directional turn; follow the new Fisher slope for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when Fisher crosses strictly above its one-period trigger after being at or below it; short when Fisher crosses strictly below its trigger after being at or above it
mechanism.why_distinct: HVFT recursively normalizes median price within its rolling extrema and applies a nonlinear log-odds transform before detecting a slope turn. It is not a raw stochastic threshold, linear band/channel, MACD/EMA state, volume force, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%; nonlinear tail expansion makes turning points in volatile range extremes explicit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour nonlinear range-transform turning clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.range_location: (median-current rolling 10-period minimum)/(rolling maximum-minimum) on 10 consecutive valid bars; zero range invalid
features.recursive_value: 0.33*2*(range_location-0.5)+0.67*prior value, clipped to [-0.999,0.999], reset after gaps
features.turn: strict Fisher/trigger crossover requiring three consecutive valid Fisher states
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers Fisher Transform turn under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no range period, recursion, clipping, transform, trigger, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: 10-period median-price range normalization; recursive value=0.33*2*(location-0.5)+0.67*prior value clipped to +/-0.999; Fisher=0.5*ln((1+value)/(1-value))+0.5*prior Fisher; trigger=prior Fisher
external_basis.selection_use: published period, recursion, clipping, transform, trigger, and crossover direction only; no incidence or outcomes
